voices.note: the mishnah 20b.10: זה הכלל ... דבר שמצותו בלילה כשר כל הלילה -- cited as the lemma at 21a.7
anonymous voice: asks לאתויי מאי and answers it, ודלא כראב"ע, דתניא
in the דתניא at 21a.8; his gezera shava on בלילה הזה
the דתניא at 21a.8 carrying REBA's gezera shava

props.gloss_en: the mishnah's rule: something whose mitzva is at night is valid the whole night
[the rule comes] to include the eating of the Paschal offerings
so, per the mishnah, the Paschal offering may be eaten the whole night (the elided object of לאתויי, rule 3)
and [the mishnah] is not in accordance with R' Elazar ben Azarya
R' Elazar ben Azarya: 'on that night' is said here (Ex 12:8) and 'on that night' there (Ex 12:12); as there until midnight, so here -- the Paschal offering is eaten until midnight
